subject: Re: Thursday studio appointment
text: I checked the appointment again after you asked about Thursday, and I think the problem is a calendar mistake rather than an actual conflict. I was confused until I checked the messages in order. Your entry says the studio walkthrough starts at ten, but I copied the time from the contractor confirmation I received last week, which said the loading dock was free at nine. When I looked closer this morning, I saw that the studio owner moved the walkthrough to ten because the painters finished late, and that note was sitting in the message folder I forgot to refresh. I can still come at ten, but if you want to use the earlier access, I can bring the equipment around nine and then meet you near the side door while they finish the last coat. Please let me know by this afternoon so I can cancel the mover or adjust the invoice. If the ten appointment is fixed, I will just bring the sample boards, the small lamp, and the fabric clips, and we can leave the heavy items for the weekend unless the room is ready earlier tomorrow.
